lessons.title: World geography
lessons.objective: Build championship-level understanding of world geography and apply it accurately to unfamiliar problems.
lessons.core_teaching_content: International knowledge connects geography, history, science, culture, institutions, economics and technology. Use location, chronology and institutional roles to anchor recall. Similar names can describe different countries or organisations, so read every qualifier. Focus specifically on world geography. Identify the core ideas, common traps, evidence or procedure needed to justify an answer, and the verification step that protects against careless errors. Practise moving from recognition to application: identify the task, select a method, execute it carefully, and check the result against all constraints. Record errors by cause so revision targets the underlying weakness.
examples: A International Knowledge Challenge problem on world geography should begin by identifying the exact clue or condition that determines the method.
Create a new world geography problem with a plausible distractor and explain why the correct solution satisfies every condition.
lessons.practical_activity: Complete a focused International Knowledge Challenge activity on world geography using a worked problem, comparison table, diagram, passage or data set as appropriate.
lessons.guided_practice: Work through three scaffolded tasks on world geography: model the first, prompt the second, and require an independent solution to the third with explicit justification.
independent_practice: Solve three unfamiliar world geography questions without viewing solutions.
Create and solve one new challenge using the lesson principle.
Analyse one error and state the rule that would prevent it next time.
lessons.assessment_checkpoint: Complete an eight-item International Knowledge Challenge checkpoint on world geography; target at least six correct and justify every uncertain answer.
lessons.student_task: Produce one finished championship task demonstrating world geography and show the reasoning or evidence used.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Coach for precise definitions, explicit reasoning and independent verification. Do not replace productive struggle with immediate answers. Suitable for self-learning.
lessons.reflection_completion: Record one strength, one recurring error and one measurable action for improving world geography.
lessons.daily_flow: Learn → Worked Example → Guided Challenge → Independent Practice → Check → Reflect
